text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin is feeling unwell, so I've
brought her
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout this... I'll rest right up and
return as
chipper as can be!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mm... Hm? City... Wh-where are we?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Jordan's here... And Palmer, too... Even
Helios...

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
It looks like our final contestant has
woken up!
Okay, let's get started!
Welcome to the City Girl
Royale!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-holy smokes!

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
It's time for you all to go head-to-head
to find
out who here is the most "city
girl" among you.

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Host
text_block_list.text:
The victor will be bestowed with the
honorary
title of "Right Proper City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. A city girl contest? We all know
I've got
this in the bag.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I got my nails done just for today,
and the pattern screams "victory." And
don't you forget,
real ones never give
up.

text_block_list.name: Helios and Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Us baddies aren't going down
without a
fight! Wahey! ☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Get your cameras ready! You'll never get
poses this perfect from an amateur! I'll
turn this whole battlefield into a runway
and slay the
competition... literally.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whatever! My UV-protection cream cuts
that
damage way down, and my custom
nails give me a
combo boost!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
We've got our own combos!
You ready,
Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bet!
Take this! Our ultimate bestie
selfie! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa! I don't really know
what's
going on here, but you're all
blow'n my mind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That being said... I really wanna be a
"Right
Proper City Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
C'monnn, secret weapon, I need you
now more'n
ever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go! ...Wait a sec, snow
geta?! The
heck're these doing here?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Urk... It's not even snow'n! What'm I
s'posed t'do
with these?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Think, think! What would a city girl do at a time like this?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City turned the field into a runway—she
made
herself a stage t'strut her stuff on.
So if I take a
page outta her book...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna slip these bad boys on and
cover the
ground in snow!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I'm shivering so much I can't hold a
pose!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my nails don't go with this snow at
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
My f-fingers are too c-cold to hold my
phone!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For reeeal!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I grew up surrounded by snow, so this is
a walk in the park! These geta are just
perfect for snowy mountains, so I can
take as many selfies as I feel
like!

text_block_list.name: City Girls
text_block_list.text: You whooped us goooood!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! ...Was I dream'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well... I hope someday, I can b'come a
right
proper city girl, just like in that
dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Looking completely refreshed, Yukino
Bijin
makes a full recovery.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It'd be pretty hard to walk in that
outfit,
don't you think? I'll lend you my
heels.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, this is too tragic to watch. You
wanna, like,
borrow some nails or
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wanna get in this pic with us, Yukino?
I'm sure a
selfie will help lift your mood!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For reeeal!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's so kind, they're practically
glow'n...
This must be that city-girl shine!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Compared to them, I'm... the runt of the
litter!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. Was I dream'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That... was frustrat'n as all get-out.
I've
got a long
ways t'go before I can hold
my own...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all that tossing and turning,
Yukino Bijin
remains exhausted.
